name: Data Analyzer: Web page's call to the API sends the key and refuses redirects
objective: Proves the web page's request to the analysis service carries the API key only to the intended address and does not follow redirects.
precondition: Offline: the web request is replaced by a canned successful answer; a made-up API key 'secret-test-key' is configured; development mode.

steps.action: Run an analysis of a small made-up table (one column 'a' with values 1, 2)
steps.expected: The request was made with redirect-following set to false, and its only header was X-API-Key with the made-up key

name: Data Analyzer: A redirect answer from the API is an error and is not followed
objective: Proves that if the service answers with a redirect, the page stops with an error mentioning 'redirect' and makes no second request.
precondition: Offline: the web request returns the canned redirect answer pointing to a made-up address; a made-up API key is configured.

steps.action: Run an analysis once for each redirect status code
steps.expected: A runtime error mentioning 'redirect' is raised each time, and exactly one request was made (no retry, no follow-up)

name: Data Analyzer: Every outgoing web request in the page code disables redirects
objective: Proves by reading the page's source code that no outgoing request was missed.
precondition: The page source file web_app.py is available; it is read but not run.

steps.action: Parse web_app.py and find every get/post/put/delete/request call made through the 'requests' library
steps.expected: At least one such call exists, and each one explicitly sets allow_redirects to the literal value False

name: Data Analyzer: In a deployed setup, an unencrypted API address is refused
objective: Proves production configuration rejects http:// for a normal host name.
precondition: Production mode with a made-up API key; no network.

steps.action: Resolve the API address and run the startup configuration check
steps.expected: The resolver raises a configuration error mentioning 'https', and the startup check reports a problem mentioning 'https'

name: Data Analyzer: In a deployed setup, an https API address is accepted
objective: Proves a correct encrypted address passes and the trailing slash is tidied.
precondition: Production mode with a made-up API key; no network.

steps.action: Resolve the API address and run the startup check
steps.expected: The address becomes 'https://api.example.invalid' (no trailing slash) and the check reports no problems

name: Data Analyzer: Plain http stays allowed for local use and for an internal service name
objective: Proves the https rule does not break legitimate local setups.
precondition: No network; addresses are only parsed.

steps.expected: Both are accepted and returned unchanged

steps.action: Resolve an address in production mode

name: Data Analyzer: A malformed API address is rejected in both development and production
objective: Proves bad addresses (wrong scheme, missing host, embedded password, query or fragment, bad port, spaces, file or script schemes) are refused everywhere.
precondition: No network; addresses are only parsed.

steps.action: Resolve each bad address in development mode and in production mode
steps.data: 10 bad addresses, e.g. ftp://..., https://, https://user:pw@..., https://...?token=1, ...#frag, ...:notaport, file:///etc/passwd, javascript:alert(1), https:/api... (20 combinations)
steps.expected: A configuration error is raised every time

name: Data Analyzer: A malformed API address makes the startup check report a problem
objective: Proves the page's startup self-check catches a bad address.
precondition: Production mode with a made-up API key.

steps.expected: At least one problem is reported
